title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on Nirmal Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd., Nagpur, Maharashtra
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBl) has, by an order dated June 30, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹1 lakh (Rupees One Lakh only) on Nirmal Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd., Nagpur, Maharashtra (the bank) for non-compliance with certain directions issued by RBI on ‘Limits on exposure to single and group borrowers/parties and large exposures and Revision in the target for priority sector lending – UCBs’ and operational instructions issued under ‘Supervisory Action Frame
